page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head at top left ("APPENDIX") and page number at top right ("249"). Above the text: the end of a decree (fragment at the top, date line, signature "Carolus.", secretary's line, and signed name) in roman and italic, right-aligned. Below that: a centred title in large black letter/roman type for Dürer's preface, followed by one preface paragraph in full-width text. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: sten tag deß monats Nouemb. Nach Christi vnsers lieben Herrn Geburt im fünffzehen hundert vnd sechß vnd zwentzigsten/vnserer Reich deß Römischen im achten / vnd der andern aller in ailffzehen jahren/ꝛc.

p.i: Ad Mandatum Cæsareæ & Catho-licæ Majestatis proprium.

main_text.head: Albrecht Dürers Præfation an Herren Bilibald Pirckey-mer.
main_text.p: Einem innsonders lieben Herren vnnd Freund/ H. Bilibald Pirckeymer/wünsch ich Albrecht Dürer Heyl vñ Seligkeit. Günstiger Herr vnd Freund/ Man hat bißhero in vnsern Teutschen Landen viel geschickter Jungen/ zu der Kunst der Malerey gethan/ die man ohn allen grund vnd allein auß einem täglichen brauch gelehrt hat/ sind dieselben also in vnverstand/ wie ein wilder vnbeschnittener Baum auferwachsen/ wiewol etliche auß ihnen durch stetig übung ein freye hand erlanget/ also daß sie ir werck gewaltiglich/ aber vnbedächtlich/ vnd allein nach ire wolgefallen gemacht haben/ so aber die verstendigen Maler

page.notes: Line 1 begins with a fragment ("sten") of the previous line, kept as printed. "ailffzehen" is the printed "ailff-" / "ten" split; the scan reads "ailff-ten", so the joined form follows the printed hyphen. The year is printed as "fünffzehen hundert" and "sechß", kept as printed. The word "ꝛc." is an abbreviation kept as printed. The marks "Ω v" at the bottom left are unclear and may be a signature or a stray ornament; the signature field is marked [?]. The title line "Pirckey-" / "mer." is joined with the printed hyphen. The preface's opening line may be set with a decorative initial "E"; read as "Einem". No marginal notes are printed on this page.
